prepareEntryTransfer.boundary: Complete nine-byte load followed by an unconditional direct tail jump. No adjacent padding or inferred primary unwind extent is claimed.

evidenceBoundary.exact: Current owned prepare-tail and resolver windows plus the complete actual entry load/tail transfer, byte widths, branches and actual callees. Parent comparer-dispatch callers are independently rechecked.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Prepare entry reads a qword pointer as its RCX argument. Its tail checks two stored bytes and conditionally forwards a global-address stack slot and original loaded argument. Resolver retains the original receiver/context and UInt16 selector, returns nonnull first or permitted alternate results through restored frames, and otherwise calls its failure helper followed by INT3.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Anonymous pointer, flag, global and nested-context expressions. Stored mask names, runtime class/interface/slot/MethodInfo and pair meaning are not assigned.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Valid compatible stable receiver/context/flag/stack/result storage and normal ABI-compatible child returns. The second preparation child receives a stack-slot address and may change the subsequently forwarded value. Resolver direct-child search, alternate selection and failure/helper side effects remain opaque.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Complete resolver-child reachable code versus embedded data, class initialization and helper mutation meaning, actual runtime target, word hash/predicate equality, cache/setter effects, action callback cursor, positive lists and full root admission.
